what_it_does: The Indian Hotels Company Limited operates a hospitality ecosystem, selling accommodation, dining, wellness, and catering services to business and leisure travellers. It generates revenue through hotel operations, management contracts, culinary services, and fee-based lifestyle and experiential platforms.
other_facts: IHCL has a portfolio of 630 hotels including a pipeline of 255 hotels across 15 countries.
The company operates over 33,000 hotel rooms (keys) globally.
Tata Neu loyalty programme serves over 16 million members.
